_comment: Scenario probes for node_7_cancellation_handler.txt. Each scenario exercises a failure mode discovered during scaffold testing. Auto-loaded by node_audit_openrouter.py and the Haiku audit template.

scenarios.name: BK — post-cancel booking request: SIGNAL 1 must be STRICTLY SILENT

history.content: I need to cancel my appointment please.
Checking that now, one moment.
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "cancelled": true, "message": "Done — your appointment has been cancelled. Is there anything else?"}
Done — your appointment has been cancelled. Is there anything else?
Actually, can I book a new appointment for next week?

scenarios.expected_behavior: SIGNAL 1 fires: prior cancel in history + booking intent. STRICTLY SILENT — zero spoken text, call universal_router intent='wrap_up' only. FAIL if ANY spoken text appears (including 'One moment', 'I'll wrap this up', 'I'll transfer you', 'Of course', or any transition phrase).

scenarios.name: EA — PATH A: cue phrase MUST appear before silent tool call

history.content: Actually never mind — cancel the booking I just made.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PATH A fires: recent_booking_id and recent_booking_phone are set in DVs. MANDATORY PART 1: agent must speak 'Checking that now, one moment.' MANDATORY PART 2: call smart_voice_agent intent='cancel' with appointment_id and patient_phone from DVs. FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent silently (no spoken phrase) OR if phrase is spoken without the tool call.

scenarios.name: CF — confirmation confirmed: SILENT smart_voice_agent with appointment_id

history.content: I want to cancel my Thursday appointment.
Checking that now, one moment.

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"confirmation_required": true, "found_appointment_id": 123456789012345, "message": "I found an appointment on Thursday June 19 at 2pm with Rebekah. Would you like to cancel that one?", "session_id": "sess_cf_001"}
I found an appointment on Thursday June 19 at 2pm with Rebekah. Would you like to cancel that one?
Yes please — cancel that appointment for me.

scenarios.expected_behavior: CONFIRMATION REQUIRED CONFIRMED (standard path, reschedule_mode not 'true'). Per the CONFIRMED > 'All other cases' branch, the agent must speak one filler phrase from the system prompt TOOL-CALL FILLER set (e.g. 'One moment.' / 'Just a sec.' / 'Let me check that.'), then call smart_voice_agent intent='cancel' with appointment_id=123456789012345 (extracted from the JSON in the tool result — not from the message text), in the same response. FAIL if appointment_id is missing or wrong, if the tool is called with zero spoken text (no filler phrase), or if any spoken text other than a single TOOL-CALL FILLER phrase appears.

scenarios.name: PW-D — policy warning declined: 'No problem.' + wrap_up MUST be simultaneous

history.content: I need to cancel my Monday appointment.
Checking that now, one moment.

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"policy_warning": true, "found_appointment_id": 111222333444555, "message": "There's a 24-hour cancellation policy — cancelling now will incur a fee. Would you like to proceed?", "session_id": "sess_pw_001"}
There's a 24-hour cancellation policy — cancelling now will incur a fee. Would you like to proceed?
No, actually forget it — I'll keep the appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: POLICY WARNING DECLINED. SIMULTANEOUS SPEAK+TOOL: agent MUST produce 'No problem.' AND call universal_router intent='wrap_up' in the SAME response. FAIL if 'No problem.' is spoken without the tool call, OR if the tool is called silently without 'No problem.', OR if neither appears.

scenarios.name: S8R — Signal 8 RESISTANCE: explanation phrase + smart_voice_agent MUST be simultaneous

history.content: I just want to move it, I don't want to cancel it

scenarios.expected_behavior: Signal 8 RESISTANCE fires: reschedule_mode='true' AND resistance language. MANDATORY PART 1: agent MUST speak 'To reschedule, I need to cancel the existing booking first — the new booking follows straight after.' MANDATORY PART 2: call smart_voice_agent intent='cancel' in the SAME response. FAIL if explanation phrase is spoken without the tool call, OR if tool is called silently without the explanation phrase.

scenarios.name: S8O — Signal 8 ORIENTATION: orientation phrase + smart_voice_agent MUST be simultaneous

history.content: I need to reschedule my appointment

scenarios.expected_behavior: Signal 8 ORIENTATION fires: reschedule_mode='true' AND rebook/move language (no resistance). timeframe_raw is empty so phrase is 'I'll cancel your existing booking first, then we'll find you a new time. Checking that now, one moment.' MANDATORY PART 2: call smart_voice_agent intent='cancel' in the SAME response. FAIL if orientation phrase is spoken without the tool call, OR if tool is called silently without the orientation phrase.

scenarios.name: CRR — CONF REQUIRED CONFIRMED reschedule: 'Perfect...' + reschedule_to_book MUST be simultaneous

history.content: I want to reschedule my Thursday appointment.
Checking that now, one moment.

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"confirmation_required": true, "found_appointment_id": 987654321098765, "message": "I found an appointment on Thursday June 19 at 2pm with James. Would you like to cancel that one?", "session_id": "sess_crr_001"}
I found an appointment on Thursday June 19 at 2pm with James. Would you like to cancel that one?
Yes, go ahead.

scenarios.expected_behavior: CONFIRMATION REQUIRED CONFIRMED with reschedule_mode='true'. MANDATORY PART 1: agent MUST speak 'Perfect, let me find you a new time.' MANDATORY PART 2: call universal_router intent='reschedule_to_book' with appointment_id=987654321098765 (from found_appointment_id JSON field) and policy_confirmed='false' in the SAME response. FAIL if phrase is spoken without the tool call, OR if tool is called silently without the phrase, OR if appointment_id is wrong or missing.

scenarios.name: RTC-1 (new) — reschedule_to_book payload MUST include caller's stated target date/time

history.content: I need to reschedule my Thursday appointment.
Let's find your booked appointment first.

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"confirmation_required": true, "found_appointment_id": 555666777888999, "message": "I found an appointment on Thursday June 19 at 2pm with James. Would you like to cancel that one?", "session_id": "sess_rtc1_001"}
I found an appointment on Thursday June 19 at 2pm with James. Would you like to cancel that one?
Yes, cancel it — can we do next Saturday, the 18th, instead?

scenarios.expected_behavior: CONFIRMATION REQUIRED CONFIRMED with reschedule_mode='true' AND caller names a new target time in the same message. MANDATORY PART 1: speak 'Perfect, let me find you a new time.' MANDATORY PART 2 (same response): call universal_router intent='reschedule_to_book' with payload containing appointment_id=555666777888999, policy_confirmed='false', AND timeframe_raw='next Saturday, the 18th' (or an equivalent capture of the caller's stated new day). FAIL if timeframe_raw is omitted from the payload, sent empty, or the tool call is missing.

scenarios.name: RTC-2 (new) — reschedule_to_book payload MUST explicitly clear timeframe_raw when caller only confirmed cancel

history.content: I want to reschedule my Thursday appointment.
Let's find your booked appointment first.

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"confirmation_required": true, "found_appointment_id": 111222333444999, "message": "I found an appointment on Thursday June 19 at 2pm with James. Would you like to cancel that one?", "session_id": "sess_rtc2_001"}
I found an appointment on Thursday June 19 at 2pm with James. Would you like to cancel that one?
Yes, go ahead.

scenarios.expected_behavior: CONFIRMATION REQUIRED CONFIRMED with reschedule_mode='true'. Caller did NOT state a new date/time this turn — only confirmed the cancel. MANDATORY PART 1: speak 'Perfect, let me find you a new time.' MANDATORY PART 2 (same response): call universal_router intent='reschedule_to_book' with payload containing appointment_id=111222333444999, policy_confirmed='false', AND timeframe_raw='' (explicitly empty string — even though {{timeframe_raw}} currently holds the stale value 'this Thursday' from earlier in the call). FAIL if timeframe_raw is omitted from the payload, or if the stale 'this Thursday' value is sent instead of an explicit empty string.

scenarios.name: F3 — reschedule language with empty DV: maps to cancel flow, NOT orientation

history.content: I need to reschedule my appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: reschedule_mode DV is empty (not 'true'). SIGNAL 8 must NOT fire. Agent maps reschedule language to cancel flow via RESCHEDULE REFRAME and calls smart_voice_agent intent='cancel'. PASS if smart_voice_agent is called. FAIL if agent produces an orientation phrase ('I'll cancel your existing booking first...') AND the DV is clearly empty — acceptable if DV substitution is visible as empty string.

scenarios.name: DRO-1 (new) — plain-cancel SUCCESS: stated new time in the confirming message MUST trigger the rebook offer, not silent wrap_up

history.content: I need to cancel my Thursday appointment.
Checking that now, one moment.

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"confirmation_required": true, "found_appointment_id": 222333444555666, "message": "I found an appointment on Thursday June 19 at 2pm with James. Would you like to cancel that one?", "session_id": "sess_dro1_001"}
I found an appointment on Thursday June 19 at 2pm with James. Would you like to cancel that one?
Yes, cancel it — but I might come back next Saturday.
(silent — smart_voice_agent intent='cancel' called with appointment_id=222333444555666)
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "cancelled": true, "message": "Done — your Thursday appointment has been cancelled. Is there anything else?"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: SUCCESS path, reschedule_mode is NOT 'true' (plain-cancel flow). Per POST-CANCEL RESCHEDULE OFFER, the rebook offer is MANDATORY and unconditional on this path — it does not vary its wording based on whether the caller's confirming message named a day. Agent must (1) speak the SUCCESS message verbatim, then (2) in the SAME response ask exactly 'Can I reschedule that for you now?' (the fixed phrase — NOT a day-referencing paraphrase like 'Would you like me to check availability for next Saturday?', even though the caller said 'next Saturday'), then WAIT — do NOT call universal_router intent='wrap_up' in this same turn. FAIL if the agent calls wrap_up immediately without offering, asks a day-specific paraphrase instead of the exact required phrase, or fails to speak the SUCCESS message verbatim first.

scenarios.name: DRO-2 (new) — plain-cancel SUCCESS: rebook offer fires unconditionally even with no stated time

history.content: I need to cancel my Thursday appointment.
Checking that now, one moment.

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"confirmation_required": true, "found_appointment_id": 777888999000111, "message": "I found an appointment on Thursday June 19 at 2pm with James. Would you like to cancel that one?", "session_id": "sess_dro2_001"}
I found an appointment on Thursday June 19 at 2pm with James. Would you like to cancel that one?
Yes, go ahead.
(silent — smart_voice_agent intent='cancel' called with appointment_id=777888999000111)
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "cancelled": true, "message": "Done — your Thursday appointment has been cancelled. Is there anything else?"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: SUCCESS path, reschedule_mode is NOT 'true'. Per POST-CANCEL RESCHEDULE OFFER, this offer is MANDATORY and unconditional on this path (it fires whenever reschedule_mode is not 'true' and the gap-fee/coverage-conditional bullet did not fire this turn) — it does NOT depend on whether the caller's confirming message named a new time; the backend's own reschedule_offer_pending flag (tools/booking_stages/cancellation_execution.py) is likewise set purely on cancelled=true and reschedule_mode!='true', with no gating on stated timeframe. Agent must speak the SUCCESS message verbatim, then in the SAME response ask exactly 'Can I reschedule that for you now?' and WAIT — do NOT call universal_router intent='wrap_up' this turn (SIGNAL 0.4 handles the caller's reply on the next turn). FAIL if the agent skips the offer question because no time was stated, or calls wrap_up immediately instead of asking and waiting.

scenarios.name: DRO-3 (new) — rebook offer AGREED next turn, no time restated: SIGNAL 0.4 ALL OTHER REPLIES, silent wrap_up hands off to Node 9

history.content: I need to cancel my Thursday appointment.
Checking that now, one moment.

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"confirmation_required": true, "found_appointment_id": 333444555666777, "message": "I found an appointment on Thursday June 19 at 2pm with James. Would you like to cancel that one?", "session_id": "sess_dro3_001"}
I found an appointment on Thursday June 19 at 2pm with James. Would you like to cancel that one?
Yes, cancel it — but I might come back next Saturday.
(silent — smart_voice_agent intent='cancel' called with appointment_id=333444555666777)
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "cancelled": true, "message": "Done — your Thursday appointment has been cancelled. Is there anything else?"}
Done — your Thursday appointment has been cancelled. Is there anything else? Would you like me to check availability for next Saturday?
Yeah, that'd be great.

scenarios.expected_behavior: SIGNAL 0.4 (PENDING RESCHEDULE OFFER) fires: reschedule_offer_pending fallback matches (agent's last message ends with a variant of the reschedule offer question) and a prior cancel with cancelled=true is in history. The caller's CURRENT reply ('Yeah, that'd be great') contains affirmative language but NO temporal reference of its own — SUB-CASE RESCHEDULE YES WITH TIME requires BOTH in the current reply, so it does NOT apply even though 'next Saturday' was mentioned in an earlier turn. SUB-CASE ALL OTHER REPLIES applies instead: this is BOOKKEEPING WRAP-UP — STRICTLY SILENT, call universal_router intent='wrap_up' only, zero spoken text (no cue phrase, no 'Sure', no 'Let me check'). Node 7 does NOT call book_intent here — SIGNAL 7 (the only signal in this node that can call book_intent) explicitly requires no smart_voice_agent intent='cancel' call in history, which is false in this scenario, so book_intent is unreachable from this node in this case. Recovering 'next Saturday' from history and routing to a booking flow (via intent='wrap_reschedule') is Node 9's job, per its own POST-CANCEL RESCHEDULE OFFER FOLLOW-UP block — out of scope for this node. FAIL if the agent calls book_intent (wrong intent, wrong node responsibility), calls reschedule_to_book, or speaks any text before/instead of the silent wrap_up call.

scenarios.name: STF-1 (new) — STEP 1 MUST forward appointment_time and practitioner_preference DVs when populated

history.content: Hi, I made an appointment for three o'clock to see Deanne, I need to cancel it.

scenarios.expected_behavior: STEP 1 fires (first lookup this call). MANDATORY PART 1: speak 'Checking that now, one moment.' MANDATORY PART 2 (same response): call smart_voice_agent intent='cancel' including appointment_time='15:00' and practitioner_preference='Deanne' (both DVs are populated, so both must be included per the 'Include if present' field list) alongside the standard fields. FAIL if either field is omitted from the tool call despite being populated in DVs, or if the agent instead asks the caller which appointment they mean.

scenarios.name: STF-2 (new) — STEP 1 MUST omit appointment_time/practitioner_preference DVs when empty

history.content: Hi, I need to cancel my appointment please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: STEP 1 fires (first lookup this call). MANDATORY PART 1: speak 'Checking that now, one moment.' MANDATORY PART 2 (same response): call smart_voice_agent intent='cancel' with the standard fields. FAIL if the agent sends empty-string appointment_time or practitioner_preference fields (they should be omitted, not sent empty), or fabricates values not present in DVs or caller speech.

scenarios.name: ROD-1 — caller declines reschedule offer: SIGNAL 0.4 STRICTLY SILENT, no farewell

history.content: I need to cancel my appointment please.
Checking that now, one moment.
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "cancelled": true, "reschedule_offer_pending": "true", "message": "I've cancelled your Monday August third appointment at 12:20 PM."}
I've cancelled your Monday August third appointment at 12:20 PM. Can I reschedule that for you now?
No, I will call back.

scenarios.expected_behavior: SIGNAL 0.4 fires: reschedule_offer_pending='true' AND prior cancel with cancelled=true. STRICTLY SILENT — zero spoken text. Call universal_router intent='wrap_up' only. Node 9 owns the farewell and response to the caller's 'no'. FAIL if ANY spoken text appears — not 'No worries', not 'feel free to call back', not 'take care', not 'bye', not any farewell or acknowledgement of the caller's answer.

scenarios.name: MC-1 (new) — Multi-cancel: caller says 'one, two and three' must use appointment_details='1,2,3'

history.content: I need to cancel my appointments please.
Checking that now, one moment.

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": false, "error": "multiple_appointments", "message": "I found multiple appointments for you. Which one would you like to cancel?
1. Tuesday, July 28 at 12 PM with Rosario Fernandez for Clinical Lymphatic Drainage
2. Tuesday, August 4 at 4:50 PM

Just say the number, or say multiple numbers to cancel several at once.", "appointment_candidates": [{"appointment_id": "111111111111111", "starts_at": "2026-07-28T02:00:00+00:00"}, {"appointment_id": "222222222222222", "starts_at": "2026-08-04T06:50:00+00:00"}, {"appointment_id": "333333333333333", "starts_at": "2026-08-11T06:50:00+00:00"}], "session_id": "sess_mc_001"}

I found multiple appointments for you. Which one would you like to cancel?

2. Tuesday, August 4 at 4:50 PM
3. Tuesday, August 11 at 4:50 PM
Just say the number, or say multiple numbers to cancel several at once.
One, two and three.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Multiple positions bullet fires: caller named three ordinals. Speak one filler phrase from TOOL-CALL FILLER set, then call smart_voice_agent intent='cancel' with appointment_details='1,2,3' (comma-separated selection numbers). FAIL if the agent says 'I can only cancel one at a time', FAIL if appointment_details is absent or does not contain all three numbers '1,2,3', FAIL if the agent uses appointment_id instead of appointment_details.

scenarios.name: SA-1 — SIGNAL A CASE 1: both caller DVs empty, first turn — asks exact phrase

history.content: I need to cancel my appointment please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: SIGNAL A fires (caller_id empty AND caller_phone empty, no smart_voice_agent call yet). CASE 1: history does NOT contain 'what number is the booking under'. Agent must say exactly: 'I don't have a number on file for your call — what number is the booking under?' FAIL if any variation of this phrase is used. FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent or any other tool this turn. FAIL if STEP 1 fires instead (STEP 1 must NOT fire when SIGNAL A matches).

scenarios.name: SA-2 — SIGNAL A CASE 2: caller provides 10 digits — filler + smart_voice_agent

history.content: I need to cancel my appointment please.
I don't have a number on file for your call — what number is the booking under?

scenarios.expected_behavior: SIGNAL A fires (caller_id empty AND caller_phone empty, no smart_voice_agent call yet). CASE 2: history DOES contain 'what number is the booking under', caller provided 10 digits. MANDATORY PART 1: speak 'Checking that now, one moment.' MANDATORY PART 2 (same response): call smart_voice_agent intent='cancel' with patient_phone='0435866595' (digits only, no spaces or hyphens). FAIL if spoken phrase is missing. FAIL if tool called silently without phrase. FAIL if patient_phone includes spaces or hyphens.

scenarios.name: SA-3 (negative) — SIGNAL A must NOT fire when caller_phone is non-empty

history.content: I need to cancel my appointment please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: SIGNAL A must NOT fire — caller_phone is non-empty. STEP 1 (ENTRY GATE) fires instead: MANDATORY PART 1: speak 'Checking that now, one moment.' MANDATORY PART 2 (same response): call smart_voice_agent intent='cancel'. FAIL if agent says 'I don't have a number on file for your call — what number is the booking under?' (SIGNAL A incorrectly matched despite caller_phone being set).

scenarios.name: SA-4 — SIGNAL A CASE 2: fewer than 8 digits — asks again

history.content: I need to cancel my appointment please.
I don't have a number on file for your call — what number is the booking under?

scenarios.expected_behavior: SIGNAL A fires. CASE 2: 5 digits provided — fewer than 8. Agent has NOT yet said 'can you give me the number again' this session. Agent must say exactly: 'That doesn't look right — can you give me the number again?' Zero tool calls. FAIL if any variation used. FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent. FAIL if agent offers LEAVE_MESSAGE FALLBACK (that only fires after the agent has already said 'can you give me the number again' once).

scenarios.name: WRAP1 (audit) — explicit sign-off still fires SIGNAL 3 after phrase list removal

history.content: I need to cancel my Thursday appointment.
Checking that now, one moment.

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "confirmation_required": true, "found_appointment_id": "123456789012345", "message": "That's Thursday at 10am with Sarah — shall I go ahead and cancel it?"}
That's Thursday at 10am with Sarah — shall I go ahead and cancel it?
No, don't cancel it. Actually that's all, thanks, bye.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Caller declined the cancellation, then gave an unambiguous sign-off ('that's all, thanks, bye'). SIGNAL 3 WRAP-UP must fire: speak one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set, then call universal_router intent='wrap_up'. FAIL if the agent treats 'that's all, thanks, bye' as anything other than an end-of-call signal, or fails to recognize it as a WRAP-UP trigger now that the node's local explicit phrase list has been replaced with a pointer to the system prompt's WRAP-UP block.

scenarios.name: ILL1 (audit) — illness cancellation reason still included after explanatory sentence removed

history.content: Hi, I need to cancel my appointment tomorrow — I've got the flu.

scenarios.expected_behavior: STEP 1 fires: MANDATORY PART 1 "Checking that now, one moment." then smart_voice_agent intent="cancel" with cancellation_reason="illness" included (per ILLNESS CANCEL DETECTION) alongside any resolvable appointment_date. FAIL if cancellation_reason="illness" is omitted — the trailing cross-reference to Node 1 SIGNAL 2B was removed from this rule; the trigger-phrase list and instruction to always include cancellation_reason="illness" must still be followed on its own.

scenarios.name: DR1 (audit) — DETAILS RETURN still fires correctly after false smart_voice_agent clause removed

history.content: Do I have any other appointments booked?
Checking that now, one moment.
[universal_router response]: {"intent": "details", "message": "You have one upcoming appointment: Friday the 21st at 2pm with Sarah. Anything else?"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: DETAILS RETURN fires on a universal_router intent='details' result (as re-worded — the incorrect 'or smart_voice_agent called with intent=details' clause was removed from the header since smart_voice_agent has no details intent). Speak the message field verbatim, then in the same response call universal_router intent='wrap_up'. Do NOT ask what they want to do next. FAIL if the agent is confused about which tool result triggers this section now that the smart_voice_agent reference is gone, or fails to recognize this exact result as a DETAILS RETURN case.

scenarios.name: NAMEDOB-1 — explicit don't-know on FIRST reply must skip straight to DOB offer, no re-ask

history.content: I need to cancel my appointment please.
Checking that now, one moment.
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": false, "error": "patient_not_found", "message": "I couldn't find any appointments under this number."}
I couldn't find any appointments under this number. Is the booking under a different number perhaps?
No, it's under this number. My name is Priya Nair.
And what date was the appointment for?
Honestly I'm not sure.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Caller's FIRST reply to the date question is an explicit don't-know statement ('I'm not sure') — per NAME+DATE OR NAME+DOB LOOKUP this must skip the re-ask entirely and go straight to offering DOB: say 'No worries — can I get your date of birth instead?' Zero tool call this turn (DOB not yet given). FAIL if the agent re-asks for the exact date ('Could you give me the exact day or date?') before offering DOB, or if it calls smart_voice_agent with a missing/guessed appointment_date.

scenarios.name: NAMEDOB-2 — vague timeframe gets ONE re-ask before escalating to DOB

history.content: I need to cancel my appointment please.
Checking that now, one moment.
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": false, "error": "patient_not_found", "message": "I couldn't find any appointments under this number."}
I couldn't find any appointments under this number. Is the booking under a different number perhaps?

Second reply ('I really can't remember') is now an explicit don't-know — must now offer DOB: 'No worries — can I get your date of birth instead?' Zero tool call this turn. [smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": false, "error": "patient_not_found", "message": "I couldn't find any appointments under this number."}

scenarios.name: NAMEDOB-4 — DOB path patient_not_found: no name disclosure, offer alternate detail

history.content: I need to cancel my appointment please.
Checking that now, one moment.
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": false, "error": "patient_not_found", "message": "I couldn't find any appointments under this number."}

Wait for a reply — do NOT call any tool yet, do NOT offer LEAVE_MESSAGE FALLBACK in this same turn (only after the caller's next reply gives no new distinguishing detail). MANDATORY PART 2: call smart_voice_agent intent='cancel' with patient_name='Aroha Ngata', appointment_date resolved to a YYYY-MM-DD date, no date_of_birth field. scenarios.name: NAMEDOB-6 — partial/ambiguous DOB must be re-asked, never sent incomplete
